name: wiki-app
description: Internal wiki demo app (Nexus) for the Cloudflare AI security workshop (web + api + mcp)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace api && npm run typecheck --workspace mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:api && npm run deploy:mcp && npm run deploy:web
